knowledge_claims.interpretation: The product has sufficient FARO coverage to describe lead quality: 1632 leads, 504 A/B leads and 76 Tier A leads.
knowledge_claims.limitation_or_uncertainty: This is FARO quality, not revenue or CRM outcome.

knowledge_claims.interpretation: Cost-quality must be read in the commercial matched universe: 12 matched ads, 1458 leads and 1069.05001 matched commercial spend, with lead_only and spend_only preserved.
knowledge_claims.limitation_or_uncertainty: lead_only is not zero cost and spend_only is not proof of no leads.

knowledge_claims.interpretation: Observed quality is explained by combinations of FARO tier, ticket_status, form/campaign concentration and ad-level coverage.
knowledge_claims.limitation_or_uncertainty: The evidence supports association, not creative causality.

knowledge_claims.interpretation: Monthly evolution is usable and June is the largest observed month; weekly comparability is partial because provider periods are incomplete at the edges.
knowledge_claims.limitation_or_uncertainty: Spend ends on 2026-07-17 while leads extend to 2026-07-22.

knowledge_claims.interpretation: The main ABO campaign concentrates most leads; ticket_status has strong descriptive separation between solo_mirando, en_proceso and tiene_billetes.
knowledge_claims.limitation_or_uncertainty: Campaign/adset economics remain partial because spend reconciliation is robust at ad_id level.

knowledge_claims.interpretation: Material limits must stay visible in both projections: revenue/CRM not_available, creative causality UNKNOWN, metadata not_available and temporal coverage partial.
knowledge_claims.limitation_or_uncertainty: Presentation cannot turn these limits into a positive or negative finding.

limitations: Revenue/CRM evidence is not_available in the authorized source set.
Creative causality remains UNKNOWN; ad_name is an interpretive label only.
Additional creative metadata beyond ad_name is not_available.
Temporal comparability is partial because spend ends on 2026-07-17 while leads extend to 2026-07-22.
Campaign/adset economic attribution is partial because robust spend reconciliation is at ad_id level.

recommendations.action: Run a controlled budget experiment among matched ads with sufficient sample.
recommendations.expected_direction: increase A/B rate or reduce cost per A/B
recommendations.hypothesis: A bounded redistribution inside commercial matched ads may improve A/B rate without worsening cost per A/B.
recommendations.population: commercial matched ad_id_norm rows with at least 20 leads and 5 A/B leads
recommendations.primary_metric: A/B rate in commercial matched universe
recommendations.stop_or_review_condition: stop if sample falls below threshold or spend coverage changes
recommendations.success_criterion: PASS if A/B rate increases versus control while cost_per_ab_commercial_matched is stable or lower over two comparable weeks.

recommendations.action: Classify every lead_only and spend_only ad_id_norm before using economic metrics for budget decisions.
recommendations.closure_criterion: all current lead_only and spend_only rows have a declared reason code
recommendations.dependency: authorized Meta lead and spend sources
recommendations.verifiable_result: coverage register classifies each asymmetry without overwriting coverage state

recommendations.action: Run a form or qualification test focused on tiene_billetes/en_proceso share.
recommendations.guardrail: lead volume and Tier A count do not collapse
recommendations.hypothesis: A form or qualification-question test can increase qualified share without requiring revenue evidence.
recommendations.population: Meta Lead Ads forms with FARO coverage
recommendations.primary_metric: share of A/B leads and ticket_status tiene_billetes/en_proceso
recommendations.stop_or_review_condition: stop if unmapped responses appear or weekly comparability remains partial
recommendations.success_criterion: PASS if qualified-share lift is observed with stable lead volume and no increase in unmapped responses.
recommendations.validation_window: one complete month or two comparable complete weeks

recommendations.hypothesis: Revenue/CRM outcomes may change FARO-only prioritization.
recommendations.promotion_condition: promote only when future evidence is authorized and reconciled
recommendations.support: FARO and ticket_status show quality strata but not commercial value.

scope.brief_instruction: Analiza la calidad de los leads de Meta Ads y genera un informe analitico y un informe ejecutivo.

unknowns: UNKNOWN: causal effect of creative/ad_name on lead quality.
UNKNOWN: commercial revenue or CRM outcome of FARO tiers.
UNKNOWN: complete current-week cost-quality pattern after provider spend cutoff.
